steps.text: These stars have twinkled above Terra since ancient times.
Just how many romantic myths and searching gazes do they hold?
Astrologers spend their lives assigning symbols to constellations and celestial bodies to give them meaning, while shamans and druids try to interpret the trails left by every passing meteor.
They are untouchable. Indeed, it is precisely because of this that the sky has become the true home of those who indulge in fantasy.
And for this great land, looking up holds no meaning.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: 6152.31 Meters. The height of Terra's sky.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: And also, the last record of the Wrights' final flight.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: No one has questioned this limit.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Nobody is angry, confused, or curious about it.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: People live on this pea wrapped so softly in a its pod, and couldn't care any less.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: And thus, came the shabby poem from an Ursine poet centuries ago.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: 'Starpod'.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Hmph. A romantic name for the barrier.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I've read through every paper related to the subject of barriers, those sloppy theories formulated by Victorian and Leithanian scholars...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: 'Analysis on Pressure in Space,' 'Theory on Density Differentials between the Barrier and Outside Matter' ...Old, outdated, and full of holes.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Those Columbian academics announcing their 'pioneer's spirit' merely tinker with that garbage. Then you get the occasional novel theory put out by younger scholars in academic journals.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: But they spend way more energy getting tenure and research grants than looking at the sky.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Oh, by the way. The test platform we launched the other day has already fallen back to the ground, due to the same old problems with the barrier.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The sudden change in basic aerodynamics, massive disruption to the Originium Zone, and the extremely rapid decay of any exogenous power.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: What about the results of the data analysis from the Transmitter?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The batch from the re-adjusted ones are solid.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I've also already laid out all the energy cables, and connected them to the port you mentioned previously.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: But, Kristen. You're well aware of just how much energy you'll need for this.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The theory is sound, however...

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: That won't be a problem.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The test platform's crash landing has caused us some trouble, and the military is burning with anxiety over your disappearance.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Kristen, whatever their next step may be, death might be the most merciful outcome.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: I wouldn't even consider that a price to pay at all.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Nasti, do you like stargazing?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Staring at something out reach just makes me feel empty.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: And yet, sometimes the unreachable can become a signboard for you.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: You are indeed right on one thing.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Death is only the most merciful outcome.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Then I hope you don't die before giving me what you promised, Control.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You should be more careful.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Thank you, I will.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Colonel? How am I supposed to take this order?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Let me guess... the agent you sent to watch Kristen has gone MIA, and you've suppressed the news.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Your superiors aren't worried about your agents being silenced by Kristen, but rather, they might have signed on with her and betrayed the country.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: And they're probably even wondering, have you betrayed the country too?

spans.text: And they're probably even wondering, have

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's no wonder you've been racing to find Kristen.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: My last tour was in Bolívar.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: In the late forties, the coalition government backed by the DOD was bumbling around like toddlers in its own jurisdiction, and our intervention policy for the Bolívarian Civil War was deemed a failure.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: The DOD's rep has fallen so low in the eyes of our people, the General even handed over control of the armed forces....

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: The DOD needs 'Arc-01' to restore its image and regain the trust of the people. And I also need it to prove myself worthy of plucking the General's medals out of the dust.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: So yeah, it is my last chance.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: But you can lay off the clownery for now, Ferdinand.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Come on, Colonel. Who are you even trying to fool with all that?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: This isn't enough of a reason for the DOD to go so far. And definitely not enough to stake your life on it.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Hey, don't you always brag about being as smart as Kristen? Why not use that clever scientist brain of yours and figure it out?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It's not like you don't know a thing about Kristen. Surely you ran a thorough check on her before handing the project over.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The situation is pretty bad, but there's definitely a contingency plan at work, your reactions have been abnormal anyway.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: If your people haven't gone crazy, then it only comes down to this...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Kristen isn't the actual reason.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No, she's just a fuse.
Ferdinand suddenly looks up at Blake, his eyes full of astonishment.
He has come to a conclusion he can barely believe himself.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You didn't meet the Vice President to talk about Kristen... what you wanted was a mood.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: The Wrights were a pair of lunatics, squandering the nation's tax money on ridiculous notions like challenging the sky.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: And all they gave back to the country was a little lunatic by the name of Kristen Wright.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Ferdinand, I respect men of your caliber.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Usually, it's your type disrespecting the nation.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Am I wrong? I can't imagine the 'meteor' that fell from the sky having any motive beyond an attempt to provoke us.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: The most generous motive I can imagine is her selling the data to another country. She holds a weapon capable of seriously damaging a nomadic city. And the military handed it right to her.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Or the worst, she actually wants to avenge her parents.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: She wants to point 'Arc-01' right at D.C., she plans to destroy the Columbia that, in her eyes, treated her parents so unfairly...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: We've already seen enough to make people wonder if they were born in the wrong era.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Hell, the scarier thing is, doesn't Jackson know about all this? Don't those Maylander agents know too?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Guess how much he already knew about Kristen, me, and you before I even walked into his room?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: But he still chose to put it off.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: I won't sugarcoat it.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: From the moment we lost Bolívar, the coalition government has spared no effort in suppressing the military.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Our current state of affairs is, to them, an excellent weapon.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: It doesn't matter if Kristen is exacting revenge or betrayal, what's important is that this is a scandal for the DOD.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: And the losses brought on by it seems to be an acceptable cost to them.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Do you want to be part of that cost, Ferdinand?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Do I even get to choose?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: If you didn't figure it out just now, you might have.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: So you can one, use your connection with me, and just wait till we've recovered 'Arc-01,' when the military will coincidentally be hiring a new scientific advisor...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Or two, die here with me, and be swept into the trashcan of history together.
Ferdinand stares at the soldier before him, confirming he's seen something in the man's eyes.
Whether pure banter or a real crisis... silence has connected the two.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: ...I get it, Colonel.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: The Vice President has already broadcast live to every citizen that Columbia is about to enter a new era.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: But accidents are inevitable on the way to said era.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: I believe he'll dedicate everything he has to realize this for Columbia.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: So that's the situation over there near the Triton factory. The parts regarding Kristen are just my own guesswork.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Judging by the military's response, that seems to hold enough water.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A superweapon that the government hopes to use to re-assert power, or Kristen herself having other plans...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Trimounts is indeed working on a secret mega project using energy at its core, with unimaginable destructive power, yet to be scientifically tested... and it's nearing completion.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That's what I'm worried about as well.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Saria, has there ever been a mass blackout in Trimounts?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Hmm? Never.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Trimounts has separate power grids for residential and commercial use, and each of their power reserves alone is enough allow all the facilities in the entire city to operate normally for several months.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Moreover, Trimounts has a booming technology industry, with dozens of companies dedicated to developing new forms of energy, and nearby mobile industrial platforms regularly borrow energy from the city.
Kal'tsit looks out the window.
The skyscraper in the distance with its gigantic glass facade frames a billow of clouds, its surface crystal clear, like a leaf full of dewdrops.
Indeed, it is just a leaf.

Her gaze expands, and the building quickly disappears into a nest of countless skyscrapers: exhibitions on science and technology interspersed with expo halls, and other specialized buildings scattered around at random, like a bacterial colony in a forest.
But, as she raises her head, the vast sky dwarfs the city, and Trimounts is only a leaf.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter if it's a superweapon ordered by the military, or an unknown object that Kristen has other plans for...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The amount of energy and precision required for the 'Horizon Arc Project' is beyond the scope of our imaginations.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Energy consumption and navigation accuracy are issues they must solve.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: So you're implying...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't know how the Columbian military has assessed the situation, or how Kristen has pulled the wool over their eyes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if she were able to solve the issue of precision, my judgement is that it cannot support energy concentration on such a scale, even if you use all of Trimounts's energy reserves.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Once you start such a huge project, it should drain Trimounts's energy in an extremely short span of time, like stuffing a giant sponge into a glass of water.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if Kristen's talents and vision are far beyond the present, the current state of science and technology should not be able to realize such a concept.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: But she is by no means a simple mad scientist indulging her delusions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Unless... she has already solved this problem.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What the heck are they talking about?

options: Stop eavesdropping. They're going to find out.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: It's gotta be about the factory that went kaboom, right? Saria looked kinda serious. Does this have something to do with Rhine?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Doctor, is Silence in Trimounts, too? Can we bring her here?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Doctor, why are you frowning like that?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh, I get it. You still blame Kal'tsit for bringing Rosmontis and me here.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: We decided to come on our own. I've been here before. I can even be your tour guide!

options: Rosmontis, you're looking at the letter again. Are you okay?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: He invited me to come back here...
The Feline girl is still holding that thin envelope in her hands. Five minutes ago, she opened it and quietly read the letter again, before stuffing it back inside a minute ago.
She lifts her head up to look at you. There doesn't seem to be any particular emotion in her eyes, but you notice something unmistakable nonetheless...
She is trying to comfort herself, almost like she is trying to smooth out a small, wrinkled piece of paper under the school desk without attracting anyone's attention.
You can feel that she is confused, maybe even in pain.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I forgot again, Doctor.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Can coming back here help me remember what I forgot? What did I forget...?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I should have it written down... I'm sure I know.

options: Rosmontis, why don't we take a little nap?
If it hurts, we can go back to Rhodes Island, right now.
Sometimes, you can turn down invitations.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I think I should stay.

options: Control your power. Don't force yourself to think. Okay?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Me too!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you have the data I need?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: We have little time to spare, but these should help.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Energy Section's project and construction plans and reports from the past ten years, Energy and Originium Art Sections' experiment records...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Scientific Investigation Section's expedition reports and data archives.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's a lot thicker than I imagined.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Their position within Rhine Lab is rather unique.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: From the corporative perspectives of cost performance and efficiency, their contributions to the company are negligible. They shouldn't even be one of Rhine's ten sections.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: And even though it doesn't rival what the core laboratories like Energy and Structural get, the budget that Rhine Lab allocates to polar field research and surveying technologies every year is no small amount...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: In fact, you could say they're throwing huge amounts of money at them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They collect and analyze seismic data from the Kazimierzian highlands surrounded by mountains in regular intervals, and have built close to ten scientific research stations in the endless icefields of Sami.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They frequently travel to Columbia's great lakes, as well as the lowland deserts in the south, for their investigations, and even seek to thoroughly explore the ruins of the abandoned cities in the Bleached Wasteland...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only a few know that the dust kicked up by pioneering young Columbia is much older than the sands of Sargon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: These scientists have not been measuring the boundaries of this world in the spirit of exploration. Rather, they are looking for something.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: These last few pages are all about Trimounts.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Trimounts? Why would Scientific Investigation need to factor in the location of Headquarters...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Every project I've checked so far has an immediate sign-off from Rhine Control.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Kristen...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And so, did this farce just happen to take place in Trimounts? Or maybe... it could only happen here...?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I would prefer to see some evidence rather than hear more of your roundabout explanations.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have some rough conjectures, but the clues are all a mess, and our present information is inadequate to serve as actual evidence.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's take a short break.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You should go have another chat with Ifrit.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Angry howling)

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Get down, Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: How is it? Does it fit?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: It's a new suit the Originium Art Section developed. I made a few adjustments, and it should fit you okay now.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: And I'm sure you know how to test out the new drone equipment.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Come here. Let me help you put the contacts in.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: That'll do it. Stand up and take a look around.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Great. You're like a completely different person.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: How are the contacts?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm not quite used to them yet.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But it's nice to go without weight on my nose.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I have to say, you look sharper without your glasses.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I'm sure your friends will be shocked as soon as they see you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'd rather surprise them another way.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Such as...?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Say... my personality.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You seize the day and work toward that. Don't underestimate what a little makeover can accomplish.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'll try my best.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Besides, the lockdown isn't going to end anytime soon. The soldiers stopped you once, and it won't be easy to get around now that they've seen you.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Get a makeover, and upgrade your equipment while you are at it. Two fowls with one stone.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It doesn't look like anyone's been here the last couple days... You came to District 13 for a reason today.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I actually bought this as a vacation home, but with how busy my workers have been lately, I haven't had much time for rest. HR Director and all.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I just located a Transmitter from Site 359 near the scene. Are you here to recover it? What does Transmitter have to do with the Triton Factory explosion?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, Dorothy wouldn't need a low-level researcher like me if you were already on the case.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ferdinand is out of the picture, but maybe there are other Sections who want Transmitter for their experiments?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I also saw Saria there... Just how many Rhine Lab personnel are involved in this?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You're asking too many questions in one go, Silence.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: And unfortunately, I can't answer them.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You should be well aware of Rhine Lab's organizational structure. The departments under General Affairs are only responsible for providing support to the Scientific Research Sections.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Originium Art, Energy, or whatever, Human Resource Investigation has never interfered in any of their research projects... I've never been a researcher myself, after all.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: My mentor told me some stories about you and Control.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Before joining Rhine Lab, you were the most eccentric and yet, the most successful investor in Trimounts.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You've never attended a single meeting, read a proposal, or listened to a project briefing, but the projects you endorse always miraculously succeed.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There's no need for you to be attached to a company. On the contrary, he said you might even become a tech pioneer to steer the course of the nation.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But after Control had one meeting with you, you announced you were joining Rhine Lab the very next day.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: The business world is always brimming with delicately packaged myths and legends.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: The outside world is full of speculation, but at my age, I don't Kristen to promise me anything. I only wanted to stay and watch her patch up a few regrets.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Some her own, and some mine.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: And well, that girl... I'm not sure where exactly she is now.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You performed very well at Site 359. You cleaned up after Dorothy, and followed the trail all the way here to recover the Transmitter. Honestly, that's remarkable.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: But the Site 359 Incident ends here, and whatever follows is already beyond the scope of both your responsibilities and abilities. You're done here.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What if I disagree, Director Jara?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Oh, let's not be rash now, I have no intention of getting in your way.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't understand... You won't tell me the truth, so why are you still helping me?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Do you remember your first day at work?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You're so reserved, but you still managed to talk non-stop for half an hour.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I was only responsible for checking your background and qualifications, you know. While I handled that, Parvis had already scored your employment exam. With high numbers.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Then why didn't you interrupt me...?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Because you're such an earnest woman, Silence.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I have a lot of respect for serious scientists, same as Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: No matter how far Kristen and the go, no matter what Rhine Lab may become... we'll always need young people like you to take over the reins someday. You are Rhine's future.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: As HR Director, my job is to protect our employees as best I can, so I advise you to leave now.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: But if you have to see it all happen with your own eyes to make your preparations and choices, then I won't hold you back either.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: That's all.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Then, I'll earnestly inform you... that I'm going to continue my investigation.
The very moment the impact force reaches you, you instinctively take the Feline girl's hand.
Evidently, she mistakes it for you being agitated about something. She relaxes her tightly clenched fists, carries you in her arms, and starts running away.
At the same time, the fiery Savra girl dashes in the other direction, her flames howling.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Leave this to me!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Rosmontis, you protect the Doctor.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'll melt all these big metal things with my flames.
Out of the way, Ifrit.
A shadow steps in front of Ifrit.
A thick wall of calcium crystals unfolds before her in an instant, blocking the power armor's onslaught. A burst of intense clashing fills the room, leaving a low, lingering hum in the air.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Saria!

options: We don't know what's going on. Let it go.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Doctor, are you hurt?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All the data are destroyed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A distraction and then immediate retreat. The enemy had a clear objective.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: There aren't many who know about this hideout.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: And there are even fewer who would stand against us.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It was Rhine Lab's mass-produced remote armors that carried out this attack.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is it someone from Rhine Lab, then?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: That's not for certain. The military has already infiltrated Rhine Lab, and decisively eliminating unknown factors in their plans is more their style.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Anyway, you seem to be on the right track. There are people who wish for us to not go any deeper into this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Or perhaps, we've been going the wrong way, and someone is trying to get us to continue our investigation.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: What is certain, at the very least, is that we have hit a critical point somewhere.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: And no matter who they are, the people behind this will pay the price.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're angry, Saria.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't let anger cloud your judgement.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If Kristen has already solved her energy troubles and cut ties with the military, then we must hurry and find the energy core she's relying on.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It shouldn't be too far from the S.H.A.F.T. under military control.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I already have a few conjectures based on my recent findings. I'll try to look for it, but I require more information.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I need to head back to Rhine.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'll go with you, Saria!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Don't be silly. I can't watch you right now.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: If you're here and you can't leave Trimounts for the time being, you should spend this time with the Doctor. Don't go anywhere.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: But the bad guys came to our doorstep looking for trouble... Besides, I helped the Doctor!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: You should—

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: No... You did great.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Be extra careful when I'm not around. Take care of the Doctor, and don't let yourself get hurt.
